**Triage** — graded `p3`, `documentation`, **`pm:queue`** (unblocked), routed `domain:devx`. **Item 3 split to #14703** (`domain:spec`). Applied and read back first.

## Unblocked: PR #14580 has landed

Your `Blocked-by: #14580` named a **PR**; the convention is that `Blocked-by:` points at an issue, and the parent #14033 is closed. Either way the dependency is discharged — `share-link-service.ts` carries the `#14033` gate on `origin/main` `c616c2c`, so the behaviour is in and the prose can follow. `pm:queue`, no blocker.

## ⭐ Item 1 is already done — do not redo it

`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx:138`, row 37, now reads:

> Get: link **creation** while the policy is off — resolution is **not** bypassed since #14033 (`publicSharing.enabled` is a standing policy held at every redemption): a link minted this way does not resolve until the block is enabled

That is your proposed cell text, landed essentially verbatim. ⛔ Strike item 1 from the scope; a claimer who works the card top-down will otherwise spend time on a fixed surface and risk re-editing a row whose five anchors are current.

## Item 3 split out

Item 3 is `packages/spec/**` — `domain:spec`, a different lane's single-owner surface, and the stop condition you named for the #14033 claim. It is now **#14703**, carrying both sites (`object.zod.ts:2237`'s "Master switch" TSDoc and `resolveToken`'s incomplete `null`-cause list) and your measured constraint that the `.describe()` string must **not** change, because it feeds `content/docs/references/**` and would require `gen:schema && gen:docs`.

## What remains here: item 2 only

`content/docs/protocol/objectql/security.mdx` — the "Public Share Links" section is at `:424`. It needs the sibling paragraph for the **parent** switch alongside the existing "When `eligibility` is enforced" paragraph and its upgrade-note callout (written for #13608 by PR #13857): off ⇒ every existing link on the object stops resolving immediately; on ⇒ they resolve again; the bypass mints but what it mints does not serve; upgrade note in the same form.

⭐ Follow #13608's paragraph shape rather than inventing one. The two predicates are now siblings in behaviour and the docs should make that visible — a reader who has understood the child predicate should recognise the parent's paragraph as the same shape one level up.

⛔ Do not touch `packages/spec/**` from this card (that is #14703). ⛔ Do not regenerate `content/docs/references/**`.

## On the filing

Recording rather than widening was right, and the three surfaces were correctly identified as outside PR #14580's claimed file surface. The one thing worth carrying forward: item 1 landed between filing and triage without the card being updated, so a follow-up card listing several surfaces should be re-measured surface-by-surface at claim time, not just at file time.
